leakage_signals: Missing preference weighting between early-access proximity/block logistics and included breakfast/confirmed in-room amenities.
Room-detail emphasis may imply an unstated preference for in-room coffee or refrigeration, but no such preference is explicitly provided.
verdict.rationale: A is defensible because a 0.2-mile official-block hotel reduces walking and event-logistics risk for 7:00 a.m. booth access, especially without a car. B is also defensible because, for only $5 more and an additional 0.4 miles, it offers a higher rating, breakfast, and explicitly listed in-room coffee and refrigeration. The query does not state how Jonah values proximity and block convenience relative to breakfast and confirmed room amenities, so neither lead recommendation is clearly dominant. C improperly makes a refrigerator a required condition without support, and D unnecessarily delays despite enough information to rank under either reasonable priority set.
